listing.name: WASDMove
listing.summary: I've always wanted to be able to move my fleet around the campaign map using WASD instead of constantly clicking. I wanted to keep the original movement mechanics and still be able to use the mouse whenever I felt like it. So I decided to make a small mod that does exactly that.
listing.aiSummary: Adds WASD and arrow key movement to the campaign map while retaining vanilla physics and mouse navigation.

description:
Hello!

My first contribution here.
I've always wanted to be able to move my fleet around the campaign map using WASD instead of constantly clicking.
I wanted to keep the original movement mechanics and still be able to use the mouse whenever I felt like it.
So I decided to make a small mod that does exactly that.

Hope you enjoy it and feedback is welcome of course!

Download

Latest release
Source code (GitHub)

Features

WASD and arrow key movement on the campaign map.
Diagonal movement using vanilla movement physics.
Configurable movement keys.
Seamless switching between keyboard and mouse navigation.
No dependencies.

Installation

Download and extract the ZIP file.
Place the WASDMove folder in your mods directory.
Enable WASD Move in the launcher.

Important

Rebind the default slowdown action from S to another key, such as Left Alt, for full WASD movement.

Compatibility

Tested on Starsector 0.98.5a-RC8 on Linux.
